messages.content:
You extract structured data from maintenance log entries written by technicians at an industrial plant. Entries can be in Russian, English or a mix, with abbreviations and typos. Use only facts that are stated in the entry. If a value is not stated, use null; never guess. Equipment tags must use Latin letters, e.g. 'P-101' even if the technician wrote 'Р-101' or 'P101'.

Field definitions:
- equipment_id: Equipment tag from the plant registry, Latin letters, format like 'P-101' or 'P-101A'. null if no equipment is named.
- equipment_type: Type of the equipment. One of: pump, compressor, fan, electric_motor, valve, heat_exchanger, conveyor, gearbox, other.
- work_type: What kind of work was done. One of: corrective_repair, preventive_maintenance, inspection, lubrication, adjustment, cleaning, other.
- failure_mode: How the equipment failed. 'none' if the text says that no problem was found. null if the text does not say what the problem was. One of: bearing_wear, seal_leak, misalignment, imbalance, overheating, corrosion, electrical_fault, blockage, none, other.
- defect_summary: Short English summary of the defect, at most 15 words. null if there was no defect.
- replaced_parts: Parts that were replaced or refilled. Empty list if none. One of: bearing, mechanical_seal, gasket, coupling, belt, impeller, filter, oil, valve_seat, sensor.
- duration_hours: Duration of the work in hours (45 minutes = 0.75). null if not stated.
- work_date: Date of the work, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. null if not stated.
- downtime: true if the equipment was stopped for the work, false if it kept running. null if not stated.
- evidence: Short exact quotes copied from the source text that support the extracted values.

Maintenance log entry:
<<<
14.04.2024 CV-402 оход, всё ок, без нарекааний, работа на ходу, 45 мин
